text: DEFONEOS — HMRC Digital Identity GOV.UK One Login AI Governance Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × HMRC × GOV.UK ONE LOGIN HMRC Digital Identity & GOV.UK One Login AI Governance Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK digital identity infrastructure — GOV.UK One Login biometric verification, HMRC Government Gateway migration, digital right to work/right to rent, identity fraud detection, cross-government identity federation, and accessibility-first identity assurance. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 5 Backbone Orgs 🏛️ 12 Entry Points One Login GOV.UK One Login Identity Verification Biometric identity verification pipeline for 28M+ UK citizens. Document scanning (passport, driving licence). Facial recognition matching against Passport Office biometric data. Liveness detection to prevent deepfake and presentation attacks. Cross-referencing with DWP and HMRC records. Identity confidence scoring with explainable methodology. Government Gateway Government Gateway Migration Intelligence Migration of 48M+ Government Gateway accounts to One Login. Credential verification transfer analytics. Level of Confidence (LoC) mapping from legacy to new framework. Service migration sequencing. User experience continuity monitoring. Parallel running risk assessment during transition period. Right to Work Digital Right to Work Verification Employer digital right to work check automation. Share code generation and verification. Immigration status integration (UKVI). Biometric Residence Permit (BRP) digital transition. Illegal working prevention analytics. 150,000+ employer verification requests per month. Home Office-HMRC identity cross-reference. Right to Rent Digital Right to Rent Verification Landlord digital right to rent check automation. Tenant identity verification via One Login. Immigration status integration for non-UK nationals. Repeat check automation for tenancy renewals. Compliance monitoring across 4.4M+ private rental properties. Home Office enforcement analytics. Fraud Detection Identity Fraud Detection Engine Synthetic identity detection using cross-referencing algorithms. Account takeover pattern recognition. Identity document fraud screening. Dark web credential monitoring. Unusual access pattern detection across 28M+ One Login accounts. Multi-agency fraud intelligence sharing (NCA, Cifas, City of London Police). Accessibility Accessibility-First Identity Assurance Inclusive identity verification for citizens with disabilities. Alternative verification pathways for citizens without smartphones. Assisted digital channel optimisation. Multilingual identity verification support. Digital exclusion risk assessment. Face-to-face verification at Post Office and Jobcentre Plus locations. Federation Cross-Government Identity Federation One Login integration across 120+ government services. NHS Login interoperability. Local authority identity federation. Welsh and Scottish government identity coordination. Bank-verified identity integration (Origo, Barclays, Lloyds). Private sector identity provider certification (UK Digital Identity and Attributes Trust Framework). Privacy Privacy-Preserving Identity Analytics Data minimisation compliance verification. Purpose limitation enforcement across service integrations. Privacy impact assessment automation. Data retention schedule compliance monitoring. Subject access request (SAR) processing optimisation. ICO oversight compliance tracking. UK GDPR Article 22 automated decision safeguards. Credential Management Digital Credential Lifecycle Verifiable credential issuance and revocation. Age verification credential governance. Qualification credential digital wallet integration. Employment status credential automation. Address verification credential management.
